24.en: @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-inquisition-items.Item.dkawZFfwGoaZJjjs]{Seekers} are the unrelenting hounds of the Inquisition: the judge, jury, and executioners of heretics and xenos alike. They are operatives used to hunting their targets behind enemy lines — whether they wield the Inquisition’s authority against them in battle or integrate themselves undercover to root enemies out from within. As much as they are expert hunters of their prey, they are also deft investigators, beating the streets to uncover clues and unravel mysteries — the Inquisition lacks for neither.

28.en: Seekers follow trails of corruption to where they are most promising, nose to the ground and teeth bared, courageous against the corruption they will face. They might be lone wolves on the hunt or leading a cell of other acolytes. In most cases, Seekers need to source local contacts and assets themselves to complete their mission successfully, to fill in skill gaps within their cell, or simply gain the advantage of superior knowledge against their foes.

32.en: Seekers are often procured from positions of minor authority within the Adeptus Terra. Many come from the ranks of the Adeptus Arbites, Macharian Vigilites, or Naval Security, where they now apply the same exacting authority against the Inquisition’s enemies. No strangers to venturing forth into the void, some Seekers who are experts in hunting psykers were once officers aboard the @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.GPqYZykonC12TJb1.JournalEntryPage.OjmVcVX5lv76LsvL]{Astra Telepathica’s} Black Ships. Those capable of dealing with xenos species may have held significant rank aboard a @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-core-items.Item.N3xtZGybYbWZlAhS]{Rogue Trader's} voidship. Regardless of origin, Seekers are favourable choices to fulfil the Duties of @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-inquisition-items.Item.z058E7qKD4CHpvoA]{Admonitor}, @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-inquisition-items.Item.upR0izJ77yCchw0b]{Deceptor}, or @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-inquisition-items.Item.eKp4XtJkKDvt42yA]{Sensor}.

36.en: Those chosen for this role must be exacting and authoritative individuals. Your Inquisitor will expect you to take charge of an investigation and wield their authority as your own, only turning to them in dire circumstances. It takes significant ambition to fill the role; you may even see yourself as an Inquisitor one day. If you prove yourself to them and, more importantly, survive, you may have a chance of taking the first step to becoming your Inquisitor’s Interrogator.
